record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: The 5 units in appliesTo declare ABILITY SWEET_SCENT: Chikorita line (range 2, maxPP 100) and Swirlix line (range 1, maxPP 80).
record.summary: Area debuff around the caster. Every enemy within a radius-3 circle (caster cell excluded) loses special defense and speed by per-star flat amounts, has its dodge chance reset to 0, and has a 30% (luck-adjusted) chance to be charmed for 1000 ms. No damage, no heal, no shield.

targeting.who: enemy units (team different from the caster) standing in cells of the radius-3 circle centred on the caster
targeting.note: requiresTarget keeps the AbilityStrategy default (true), so the caster needs a target to cast; the target is only used for the cast animation, the area is centred on the caster. The strategy never reads the target.

geometry.shape: circle of radius 3 around the caster, caster cell excluded
geometry.detail: getCellsInRadius(x, y, 3, false): radius becomes floor(3)+0.5 = 3.5 and a cell qualifies if dx^2+dy^2 < 12.25 and it is on the board; includesCenter false skips the caster cell.

effects.scaling: addSpecialDefense(-spDefLoss, caster, apBoost 1, crit): value = round(-spDefLoss x (1 + caster.ap/100) x (critPower if crit)). Crit is false unless the cast rolled a crit (needs ABILITY_CRIT; canCritByDefault false). The target's speDef is floored at 0 after the Big Eater Belt and Twist Band hooks (bodies not read).
effects.resolution: in addSpecialDefense: rounding, then applyBigEaterBeltStatBuff and applyTwistBandBuff hooks, then speDef = max(0, speDef + value).

effects.scaling: addSpeed(-speedLoss, caster, apBoost 1, crit): after the item hooks the value is multiplied by (1 + caster.ap/100) and critPower if crit (no rounding in addSpeed); speed is clamped to 0..MAX_SPEED. MELMETAL-passive targets convert the change into an attack change instead (half the value).
effects.resolution: in addSpeed: Big Eater Belt and Twist Band hooks, MELMETAL special case, AP/crit scaling, clamp.

declaredRaw.note: sets dodge to 0 by adding -current dodge

effects.scaling: addDodgeChance(-target.dodge, caster, apBoost 0, crit false): the amount is the target's whole current dodge, so dodge goes to 0 before the item hooks; applyBigEaterBeltStatBuff and applyTwistBandBuff (bodies not read) may alter the value, so the result is 0 only if they do not.
effects.resolution: dodge = min(0.9, dodge + value). The dodge roll in the basic-attack path uses target.dodge (chance(dodgeChance, target, 0.9)).

effects.target: each enemy in the circle, independently
effects.scaling: chance(0.3, caster): Math.random() < min(1, 0.3^(1 - luck/100)) with the caster's luck. triggerCharm(1000, enemy, caster, apBoost false): duration is not AP-scaled.
effects.resolution: triggerCharm does nothing if the target is already charmed or has runeProtect; otherwise duration x1.3 in MISTY weather, then applyStatusDurationReductions, charm set with the caster as origin and the enemy's target set to the caster. Charm's combat effect (updateCharm, attack behaviour) was not read.

starBehavior.note: Caster stars index both tables (1-4, fallback 10 / 20). Catalog units are 1, 2 or 3 stars; charm chance, duration and radius do not vary by star.

record.positionalConditions: Only enemies whose cell is within the radius-3 circle around the caster are affected; allies and the caster's own cell are skipped (team test and includesCenter false).
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state or modes. Each cast subtracts the loss again (speDef floored at 0, speed at 0) and resets dodge again; charm cannot be reapplied while the target is still charmed.
record.rawVsResolved: Declared raw: speDef loss 4/6/8 and speed loss 10/12/15 for 1/2/3 stars, charm 30% for 1000 ms. speDef loss is scaled by (1 + AP/100) and rounded; speed loss is scaled by (1 + AP/100) without rounding; charm probability follows luck, duration is unscaled. Item hooks may change all values.
